episode_title: Episode 192: Providing Maternal Care For Modern Moms | Melissa Denning, Founder of MomAid

real_qa.q: What problem does the Bubéd nursing pad solve that existing nursing pads on the market lack?
real_qa.r: Existing nursing pads have not evolved since they were invented and are simply cotton circles designed to absorb leaky milk with no additional protection for wounds and fissures that develop during breastfeeding. The Bubéd nursing pad differentiates itself with a silicone center that won't stick to healing wounds and skin while still allowing ointment to absorb into the skin rather than the pad, combined with cotton and SAP (super absorbent polymer) on top to maintain milk absorption capabilities.
real_qa.requete: Bubéd nursing pad silicone center difference

real_qa.q: What are the key ingredients in MomAid's Tiny Toosh diaper cream that differentiate it from standard zinc oxide-based formulations?
real_qa.r: MomAid's Tiny Toosh diaper cream contains 15% zinc oxide for protection, but differentiates itself with castor oil and tallow that make it smooth and luxurious to spread, along with Manuka oil (the oil extracted from Manuka honey rather than the honey itself) which helps deliver nutrients and healing benefits deep into irritated, inflamed skin.
real_qa.requete: Tiny Toosh diaper cream tallow castor oil ingredients

real_qa.q: When did MomAid's patent for nursing pads transition from provisional to approved status?
real_qa.r: The patent for the nursing pads was approved in July, with the approval coming at the end of July or beginning of August. The full patent process takes approximately 18 to 24 months from initial filing, starting with a provisional patent that acts as a placeholder for 18 months before filing the non-provisional patent and paying the full fee.
real_qa.requete: MomAid nursing pad patent approved July 2024

real_qa.q: How has Melissa Denning used her real estate sales skills to build the MomAid business?
real_qa.r: Denning's real estate career, where she works from beginning to end with clients on one of their biggest life purchases, has helped her develop strong interpersonal and communication skills. Her aggressive, blunt, and direct personality—learned from her single mother who didn't have time to waste—translates to how she approaches business conversations and doesn't shy away from difficult discussions.
real_qa.requete: real estate skills building startup business communication

real_qa.q: Why did Melissa Denning invent the Bubéd nursing pad specifically in 2023?
real_qa.r: After experiencing wounds and fissures while breastfeeding her youngest child, Denning searched the internet for hours looking for a product that would both protect healing wounds and absorb leaky milk, and found nothing suitable existed on the market. This gap led her to work with a design engineering firm (after interviewing three options) to develop and hone the Bubéd nursing pad invention.
real_qa.requete: why create Bubéd nursing pad 2023 breastfeeding wounds

guest.bio_context: Melissa Denning is a mother of three (ages 15, 13, and 4) from Purcell, Oklahoma, who grew up in a small town of approximately 6,000 people where she showed hogs and sheep and rode horses. After graduating in 2008 during the financial crisis with a marketing degree and minor in economics, she worked at a marketing firm before transitioning to real estate, where she has been a top-producing realtor for 11 years. She later pursued a master's degree in marketing management and bootstrapped her startup MomAid through profits from her real estate business.
